name: git-release-skills
description: Official Claude Code skills for git-release, the Git Flow-style release candidate CLI — RC branch lifecycle, feature-list management, deploy-trigger branches, and repo setup.

plugins.name: git-release
plugins.description: How to cut and ship release candidates from Claude Code with the `git-release` CLI: the git-config state model, roll vs next vs append, the disposable deploy-trigger contract, and which commands are interactive and must not be run unattended. Wraps the `git-release` CLI; installs no tools.
